full_page.content:
Page 148 May 26 Jay Deeg - 6 - from All Saints - fits not too bad but. .. bright look- ing child Drs. fear not normal ...
26 Wm VanPoucker - 69 - wife dropped dead (last) Easter Sunday and the shock completely unnerved him - nos in St. Mary's Hospt'l - strapped down
27 Thanks Paul Amcel - 20 - in the Marines - enrolled in February in quite threatening condition of back. Drs. figured on putting in cast for nine months. "OKnow now". father enrolls him as a perpetual member.
27 Ben Trudeau - Cheboygan, Mich. - 46 - has wife and eight children, has sorosis of liver. Drs. give very little encouragement.
Wm. Saier - 81 - sight in one eye failing. Has to climb ladders and file saws and paint houses for support of self and wife - children all married and away.
28 Baby James Oliver - 6 - mo - torn membrane leading to brain causing blindness - give him six months more to live. Father non Catholic - Has promised to take instruction if child is spared, etc.
Page 149 May 28 Raymond Ver Commen - 3 - Drs fear T.B. - Father was cured several yrs. ago . . . . .
Mrs. Lura Lafler - 60 - serious arthritic condition 11 yrs. lately getting worse.
1944, June
June June 1 Dr. Andrew Biddle - 83 - Stroke in February, Coming along fine but impatient to walk ..
Casimir Sliwinski - 42 - of Saginaw - colitis and ulcers of intestines. Robert Weiman - 19 - pneumonia in "Saratoga" Hospital (near Gratiot) Father never had marriage blest .... promises ... Enrolls .. 1.00
4 Louise Woelkers - 32 - Tape-worm since March 1943. Trouble and Dr. bills .... Enrolled To-day perpetually. Mother promising ... . frequent Communion and to Enroll whole Fam perpetually .. if ...
James Wright - 27 - neglecting wife and child - married out of Church ..
